environment.description: EKS cluster (v1.28) running the pod with a Kubernetes Service of type LoadBalancer directly exposing port 8080 to the internet. No ingress controller, no service mesh sidecar, no network policies. The ALB is configured in TCP passthrough mode with no authentication rules. Pod runs in namespace 'monitoring' with default service account.

config.ingress: none - direct NLB to pod port 8080
